newsitem.title: HONG KONG: U.S. investor to take Pam & Frank stake.
newsitem.headline: U.S. investor to take Pam & Frank stake.

text.p: Pam & Frank International Holdings Ltd said under a conditional restructuring plan, a U.S. investor was set to take a stake of over 35 percent in Pam & Frank after injecting a minimum HK$60.5 million in the company.

The company said in a statement on Monday that the U.S. investor had advanced HK$10 million to the group to reduce outstanding debt and would inject a minimum HK$60.5 million by subscribing to a convertible bond issue and buying new shares.
It said the investor would apply to the Securities and Futures Commission for a waiver of the requirement to make a general offer for the company's shares.
Pam & Frank also said that under the restructuring proposals, it would convert part of its bank debt into shares and pay down some debt through the sale of properties.
"The balance of the banks' indebtedness will be written off."
It said the properties to be sold would not include its manufacturing site at Bao An Industrial Park in China.
Pam & Frank said it aimed to settle the deal by February 28.
Trading in the shares of the sports bag maker was suspended on August 14, 1996, and the company said trading in its shares and warrants would remain suspended.
The stock last traded at HK$0.22.
